what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: Remote meeting on Zoom (Meeting ID 766 316 7607, https://us02web.zoom.us/j/7663167607?omn=88413669818); broadcast later on Lunenburg Public Access cable, Facebook, and YouTube within 24 hours

items.agenda_line: a. Change in Job Description from Business Administrator to Director of Finance and Operations (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: It changes the job description of the district's top business and finance position, which affects who manages school finances and operations.

items.agenda_line: b. Appointment of Temporary Director of Finance and Operations (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: It concerns who will fill the district's finance and operations leadership role on a temporary basis, a hiring decision.

preview.hook: A redefined school finance job and a temporary Director of Finance and Operations
preview.one_line: School Committee meets by Zoom Oct 1 at 7pm on a job-description change to Director of Finance and Operations and a temporary appointment to that post.
